name: Axe/Mace
description: Defaults: DX-5, Flail-4, or Two-Handed Axe/Mace-3. The skill of using one-handed axes, maces, and picks, including vibro-axes. Can be taken as a specialty of Melee Weapon.

name: Brawling
description: Defaults: DX-0. Proficiency in unarmed fighting, from bar-room brawls to disciplined martial arts. Covers punches, kicks, and grappling.

name: Broadsword
description: Defaults: DX-5, Force Sword-4, Jitte/Sai-3, Saber-4, Shortsword-3, Smallsword-4, or Two-Handed Sword-4. The skill for balanced, one-handed blades like ancient metal swords or certain vibro-swords. Can be taken as a specialty of Melee Weapon.

name: Gunner
description: Defaults: DX-4 or IQ-5. The skill of firing aimed, turreted weapons, such as those found on starships, ground vehicles, and fixed emplacements. Requires a specialty (e.g., Gunner (Turbolaser), Gunner (Ion Cannon)).

name: Guns
description: Defaults: DX-4. The ability to operate, maintain, and accurately fire personal ranged weapons. This is the primary skill for any dedicated gunslinger. Requires a specialty (e.g., Guns (Blaster Pistol), Guns (Blaster Rifle), Guns (Heavy Blaster), Guns (Slugthrower)).

name: Judo
description: No Default. A form of unarmed combat focused on throws and grappling to use an opponent's momentum against them. A more defensive alternative to Brawling.

name: Karate
description: No Default. A disciplined form of unarmed striking with hands and feet, allowing for more damaging and precise blows than standard Brawling.

name: Knife
description: Defaults: DX-4, Force Sword-3, Main-Gauche-3, Shortsword-3. The specific skill of fighting with small blades, from simple combat knives to vibro-daggers. Can be taken as a specialty of Melee Weapon (Vibro-knife).

name: Melee Weapon
description: Defaults: DX-5. Proficiency with a specific category of non-lightsaber melee weapons. Requires a specialty (e.g., Melee Weapon (Vibro-knife), Melee Weapon (Gaffi Stick), Melee Weapon (Sword)).

name: Shield
description: Defaults: DX-4 or Brawling-4. The skill of using a physical shield for defense. This includes personal energy shields that are handheld, as well as riot shields and ancient metal shields.

name: Spear
description: Defaults: DX-5, Polearm-4, or Staff-4. The skill of using spears, from primitive wooden spears to high-tech force pikes (that are not lightsabers).

name: Staff
description: Defaults: DX-5, Polearm-4, or Spear-4. Covers fighting with any sort of staff or long stick, including the weapons of the Gand and the non-powered staves used by some guards.

name: Two-Handed Sword
description: Defaults: DX-5, Broadsword-4. The skill for wielding large, heavy blades with two hands, such as ancient greatswords or large vibro-greatswords.

name: Thrown Weapon
description: Defaults: DX-4. The skill of accurately throwing weapons, from knives and grenades to improvised projectiles. Requires a specialty (e.g., Thrown Weapon (Knife), Thrown Weapon (Grenade)).

name: Acrobatics
description: No Default. The skill of tumbling, balancing, and performing complex gymnastic feats, often used to entertain or to gain a tactical advantage in combat (e.g., bonuses to Dodge).

name: Body Language
description: Defaults: Per-5 or Empathy-3. The skill of reading the posture, gestures, and expressions of others to discern their emotional state and intentions. Essential for interrogators and diplomats.

name: Climbing
description: Defaults: DX-5 or ST-5. The skill of scaling vertical surfaces, from rock faces to the sides of buildings.

name: Escape
description: Defaults: DX-5. The art of slipping out of bonds, handcuffs, or grapples.

name: Filch
description: Defaults: DX-5. The skill of picking pockets and subtly stealing small objects from a person.

name: Flight
description: Defaults: HT-5. The skill for maneuvering with natural wings or a personal flight system like a jetpack.

name: Holdout
description: Defaults: IQ-5 or Sleight of Hand-3. The art of concealing weapons and gear on your person beyond what is allowed by the Concealment skill, especially against a pat-down search.

name: Jumping
description: Defaults: DX-4. The ability to make controlled leaps, covering horizontal or vertical distances.

name: Running
description: Defaults: HT-0. The skill for sustained overland running, essential for pursuits or long-distance travel on foot.

name: Sleight of Hand
description: Defaults: DX-6. The skill of tricking the eye with fast hand movements, used for magic tricks, cheating at cards, or planting an object on someone.

name: Speed-Reading
description: Defaults: IQ-5. The ability to scan and absorb written information at a rapid pace.

name: Swimming
description: Defaults: HT-4. The ability to move effectively through water.

name: Vacc Suit
description: Defaults: DX-5. The skill for operating within a sealed environmental suit or vacuum suit, including maneuvering in zero-gravity conditions.

name: Acting
description: Defaults: IQ-5, Fast-Talk-3. The ability to convincingly portray a role, impersonate others, or feign emotions. While a social skill, it is fundamentally a performance art.

name: Carousing
description: Defaults: HT-0. The art of socializing in cantinas, bars, and clubs. Success can lead to valuable contacts, rumors, or simply a good time.

name: Detect Lies
description: Defaults: Per-6 or Psychology-4. The skill of spotting falsehoods by observing a subject's speech patterns, body language, and physiological reactions.

name: Diplomacy
description: Defaults: IQ-6, Fast-Talk-4, or Leadership-4. The art of negotiation, mediation, and statecraft. It is the key skill for reaching peaceful agreements, forging treaties, and representing a faction's interests.

name: Expert Skill
description: This skill represents deep, specialized knowledge in a field not covered by other skills. It has no default. Example: Expert Skill (Jedi Lore) (IQ/Hard), Expert Skill (Sith Lore) (IQ/Hard).

name: Fast-Talk
description: Defaults: IQ-5. The skill of bending the truth and weaving convincing lies to get out of trouble or gain an advantage.

name: Heraldry
description: Defaults: IQ-5. The skill of identifying noble houses, military divisions, corporate logos, and other symbols of power and allegiance by their emblems.

name: Intimidation
description: Defaults: Will-5. Using threats, displays of force, or sheer presence to cow others into submission or extract information.

name: Interrogation
description: Defaults: IQ-5, Intimidation-3, or Psychology-3. The skill of extracting information from a resistant subject through questioning, psychological pressure, or intimidation

name: Leadership
description: Defaults: IQ-5. The ability to inspire confidence, direct troops in combat, and command respect from subordinates.

name: Merchant
description: Defaults: IQ-5 or Market Analysis-3. The skill of buying and selling goods, haggling prices, and assessing the value of cargo.

name: Politics
description: Defaults: IQ-5 or Leadership-4. The skill of navigating and influencing governmental and bureaucratic systems, understanding power dynamics, and using procedures to your advantage.

name: Propaganda/TL
description: Defaults: IQ-5 or Psychology-4. The art of creating and disseminating information to shape public opinion on a massive scale.

name: Research
description: Defaults: IQ-5. The skill of effectively finding information from archives, libraries, computer networks, and other large repositories of data.

name: Savoir-Faire
description: Defaults: IQ-4. Knowing the proper etiquette, customs, and protocols of a specific social group. Requires a specialty (e.g., Savoir-Faire (Military), Savoir-Faire (Noble Court), Savoir-Faire (Corporate), Savoir-Faire (Underworld)).

name: Streetwise
description: Defaults: IQ-5. Knowledge of the criminal underworld, including how to find black markets, deal with smugglers, and navigate the unwritten laws of the street.

name: Teaching
description: Defaults: IQ-5. The ability to effectively impart knowledge and skills to students.

name: Camouflage
description: Defaults: IQ-4. Using available materials to blend into the surroundings.

name: Concealment
description: Defaults: IQ-5. The art of hiding objects—or oneself—on one's person, in a room, or within a vehicle to avoid detection.

name: Shadowing
description: Defaults: IQ-5. Following a target discreetly through various environments without being noticed.

name: Stealth
description: Defaults: DX-5. The ability to move silently and remain unseen, crucial for infiltration and ambushes.

name: Administration
description: Defaults: IQ-5. The skill of managing organizations, overseeing logistics, and navigating bureaucracy.

name: Archaeology
description: Defaults: History (any)-5. The study of past cultures through their physical remains.

name: Area Knowledge
description: No Default. Detailed knowledge of a specific city, planet, or region, including its layout, key figures, and hidden places. A specialty is required (e.g., Area Knowledge (Coruscant Underlevels)).

name: Astronomy/TL
description: Defaults: Navigation (Hyperspace)-5. The scientific study of stars, planets, and celestial phenomena.

name: Criminology
description: Defaults: IQ-6. The systematic investigation of crime scenes, analysis of forensic evidence, and understanding of criminal psychology.

name: Current Affairs
description: Defaults: IQ-4. Keeping up with recent events, political shifts, and notable figures. Requires a specialty (e.g., Current Affairs (Galactic Politics), Current Affairs (Outer Rim Territories), Current Affairs (Underworld)).

name: Cryptography/TL
description: Defaults: IQ-6 or Mathematics-3. The skill of creating and breaking codes and ciphers.

name: Diagnosis
description: Defaults: First Aid-5 or Physician-5. The skill of identifying diseases and medical conditions in living beings.

name: Gambling
description: Defaults: IQ-5. Playing games of chance like Pazaak or Sabacc, calculating odds, and spotting cheaters (or cheating effectively).

name: History
description: Defaults: Archaeology-5 or Bard-3. Knowledge of past events. Requires a specialty (e.g., History (Galactic Republic), History (Sith Empire)).

name: Law
description: No Default. Knowledge of the legal codes and procedures of a specific government. Requires a specialty (e.g., Law (Republic), Law (Hutt Cartels)).

name: Linguistics
description: No Default. The analytical study of the structure of language itself, which can help in deciphering unknown tongues.

name: Mathematics/TL
description: No Default. Understanding of advanced mathematical principles, essential for physics, engineering, and cryptography.

name: Metallurgy/TL
description: Defaults: IQ-6. The science of metals, their properties, and how to refine and work them. Essential for creating advanced alloys like Beskar.

name: Naturalist
description: No Default. Expert knowledge of the flora and fauna of a specific environment or planet.

name: Navigation
description: Defaults: IQ-6. The skill of plotting a course from one point to another. Requires a specialty (e.g., Navigation (Hyperspace), Navigation (Planetary), Navigation (Urban)).

name: Philosophy
description: No Default. The study of fundamental questions about existence, knowledge, values, and reason. Requires a specialty (e.g., Philosophy (Jedi), Philosophy (Sith)).

name: Poisons
description: Defaults: Chemistry-4. The skill of identifying, creating, and applying toxins.

name: Traps/TL
description: Defaults: IQ-5 or Demolitions-3. The skill of detecting, disarming, and setting non-explosive traps.

name: Tactics
description: Defaults: IQ-6. The skill of planning and executing strategies in combat, from small-unit ambushes to large-scale fleet engagements.

name: Tracking
description: Defaults: Per-6. The ability to follow physical trails and interpret signs left by people, creatures, or vehicles.

name: Psychology
description: Defaults: IQ-6. Understanding the motivations, behaviors, and mental states of sentient beings.

name: Survival
description: Defaults: Per-5. The ability to find food, water, and shelter in hostile wilderness environments. Requires a specialty (e.g., Survival (Desert), Survival (Forest), Survival (Tundra)).

name: Architecture/TL
description: Defaults: Engineer (any)-4. The skill of designing buildings and other large structures.

name: Armoury
description: Defaults: IQ-5. The skill of performing routine maintenance and field repairs on weapons. For extensive customization or fabrication, see the Armstech skills below. Requires a specialty (e.g., Armoury (Blasters), Armoury (Heavy Weapons), Armoury (Melee Weapons)).

name: Armstech (Melee)/TL
description: Defaults: Armoury (Melee Weapons)-4, Electronics Repair (Energy Weapons)-5, or Metallurgy/TL-5. Prerequisite: Armoury (Melee Weapons). A master craftsman's knowledge of building and modifying advanced melee weapons. This skill fuses traditional weaponsmithing with advanced materials science and micro-electronics.

name: Armstech (Armor)/TL
description: Defaults: Armoury (Body Armor)-4, Electronics Repair (Sensors)-5. Prerequisite: Armoury (Body Armor). A specialized expertise in designing, fabricating, and modifying advanced personal armor. This skill covers working with laminate plates, weaving in energy-dispersive underlays, and integrating electronic systems.

name: Brewing
description: Defaults: Cooking-4. The art of making alcoholic beverages, from Corellian ale to Tatooine moonshine.

name: Cooking
description: Defaults: IQ-4. The ability to prepare palatable and nutritious food.

name: Computer Operation
description: Defaults: IQ-4. The basic use of computer systems, including accessing public datapads, searching the HoloNet, and operating standard shipboard terminals. For illegal access, see Security.

name: Demolitions
description: Defaults: IQ-6. The safe handling, placement, and detonation of explosives, as well as the disarming of enemy charges.

name: Droid Engineering/TL
description: Defaults: Robotics/TL-4, Mechanic (Robotics)-4. Prerequisite: Robotics/TL. The master skill for designing, building, modifying, and repairing droids. This covers everything from installing heavy armor plating and advanced processors to writing new skill programs and repairing battle damage.

name: Driving
description: Defaults: DX-4. Operating ground-based vehicles. Requires a specialty (e.g., Driving (Land Speeder), Driving (Repulsor-Tank), Driving (Swoop Bike)).

name: Electronics Operation
description: Defaults: IQ-5. Operating complex electronic equipment. Requires a specialty (e.g., Electronics Operation (Comms), Electronics Operation (Sensors), Electronics Operation (Medical)).

name: Electronics Repair
description: Defaults: IQ-5. The skill of diagnosing and repairing damaged electronic devices. Requires a specialty matching those in Electronics Operation.

name: Engineer
description: Defaults: IQ-6. The skill of designing, building, and performing major overhauls of complex systems. Requires a specialty (e.g., Engineer (Hyperdrive), Engineer (Starship Drives), Engineer (Weapons Systems)).

name: First Aid
description: Defaults: IQ-4. The skill of providing immediate medical care, stopping bleeding, setting bones, and stabilizing critically wounded patients until advanced medical attention is available.

name: Force Field Technology/TL
description: Defaults: Electronics Repair (Force Fields)-4, Physics (Force Fields)-4. Prerequisite: Electronics Repair (Force Fields). A highly specialized skill representing a deep understanding of protective energy fields. A character with this skill can design, build, repair, and modify personal and vehicle-scale shield generators.

name: Forgery/TL
description: Defaults: Artist-4. The skill of creating convincing fake documents, ID cards, and other credentials.

name: Lockpicking
description: Defaults: DX-5. The art of opening mechanical locks without the original key.

name: Piloting
description: Defaults: DX-4. Operating vehicles in three-dimensional space, including atmospheric and space flight. Requires a specialty (e.g., Piloting (Starfighter), Piloting (Freighter), Piloting (Speeder Bike)).

name: Scrounging
description: Defaults: IQ-4. Finding useful items, spare parts, or resources in scrap heaps, battlefields, and abandoned areas.

name: Security
description: Defaults: IQ-5. The skill of bypassing security systems. This covers both electronic 'slicing' (bypassing computer security, decrypting files) and defeating physical systems like mag-seals and laser grids.

name: Mechanic
description: Defaults: IQ-5 or Engineer-4. The skill of repairing and maintaining machinery. This is a broad skill that requires a specialty. Examples: Mechanic (Hyperdrive), Mechanic (Repulsorlift), Mechanic (Life Support), Mechanic (Robotics).

name: Pharmacy/TL
description: Defaults: Chemistry-5. The science of compounding and dispensing medical drugs, from simple kolto packs to advanced combat stims.

name: Healing
description: Prerequisites: Force Sensitive, relevant Force power. Description: The ability to channel the Force to mend wounds, purge toxins, and restore vitality in living beings.

name: Influence
description: Prerequisites: Force Sensitive, relevant Force power (e.g., Mind Trick). Description: The skill of subtly influencing the thoughts, emotions, and perceptions of others through the Force.

name: Lightsaber Combat
description: Prerequisites: Force Sensitive. Description: The signature skill for wielding a lightsaber. Because a lightsaber can form a solid defensive barrier, this skill can be used for both Parry (vs. melee) and Block (vs. ranged). The calculated value for both defenses is (Skill/2) + 3. Note that successfully defending against blaster bolts specifically requires the Danger Sense advantage to anticipate the shot.

name: Lightsaber Construction
description: Prerequisites: Force Sensitive, Lightsaber Combat-12+. Description: The art and meditation of building a lightsaber from its core components. This involves gathering and attuning a kyber crystal, assembling the hilt, and aligning the emitter matrix. This requires a dedicated workbench and appropriate tools.

name: Mind Control
description: Prerequisites: Force Sensitive, relevant Force power. Description: The ability to directly dominate the will of another sentient being, forcing them to obey commands. This is a powerful and dangerous application of the Force.

name: Movement
description: Prerequisites: Force Sensitive, relevant Force power (e.g., Force Jump, Force Speed). Description: The skill of using the Force to push one's body beyond its natural physical limits, enabling superhuman feats of speed, agility, and leaping.

name: Sense
description: Prerequisites: Force Sensitive. Description: The fundamental skill for perceiving the universe through the Force. It allows a user to detect presences, feel disturbances, sense emotions, and gain insights beyond the five conventional senses. The GM may allow Will-based rolls for purely intuitive feats.

name: Telekinesis
description: Prerequisites: Force Sensitive, relevant Force power (e.g., Force Push/Pull). Description: The ability to manipulate physical objects and project kinetic force at a distance, from levitating small stones to blasting enemies off their feet.

name: Artist
description: No Default. The skill of creating works of visual art. This could include painting, sculpture, holo-sculpting, or creating intricate calligraphic works. A successful roll produces a work of quality, while a critical success might create a true masterpiece.

name: Musical Instrument
description: No Default. The skill of playing a specific musical instrument. Requires a specialty (e.g., Musical Instrument (Kloo Horn), Musical Instrument (Fizz)).

name: Singing
description: Defaults: HT-4. The skill of producing musical tones with the voice, from cantina performances to operatic arias.

name: Writing
description: Defaults: IQ-5. The skill of composing clear, persuasive, or entertaining text. This can be used to write anything from stirring political pamphlets and journalistic reports to poetry and epic ballads about the war.
